messages:
kai: thinking about launching a small, taint-aware GPU nodepool in europe-west6 for latency-sensitive mini-models (short seq lengths). Need recommendations on instance type mix, autoscaler bounds and quota ask. aim: 10-30 qps p95 < 120ms. :thinking:

marta: first question — is this for hosted traffic or dedicated customers? quotas differ and so do egress requirements.

kai: hosted traffic but will be used by canary customers initially; we want isolation (taint + nodeSelector) so other workloads can't land. also want a cheap burst option.

ryan: cost-wise best bet is A10G for compact models, A100 if you need FP16 perf, H100 is overkill unless you need 4k context. A10G can be preemptible/spot for burst. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

sasha: driver stack note — if you go mixed (A10G + A100) we need to pin GPU operator / driver versions and test the node-image. different kernels break NVML behavior.

infra-bot: quota-check result: project redwood-prod in europe-west6 has GPU quota: A10G=8 GPUs, A100=2 GPUs, H100=0 GPUs. Request pipeline: https://go/infra-quotas (automated check) :white_check_mark:

marta: given that, I'd request A10G quota bump to start; ask for 32 GPUs to allow 8-12 nodes. include justification: low-latency canary + burst; we will tag with billing project and autoscaler limits.

dev: here's a minimal nodepool terraform snippet we used elsewhere, pls adapt:```hcl
resource "google_container_node_pool" "gpu_compact" {
  name       = "gpu-compact-ew6"
  cluster    = var.cluster
  node_config {
    machine_type = "n1-standard-16"
    accelerators {
      type  = "A10G"
      count = 1
    }
    taints = ["llm=latency:NoSchedule"]
  }
  autoscaling {
    min_node_count = 2
    max_node_count = 12
  }
}
```

sre-oncall: make sure to add a PodDisruptionBudget and drain-safety for the nodes. Also add node-autoprovisioning disabled for this pool. For canaries set max surge to 1 to avoid capacity cliffs.

kai: autoscaler question — we want slow scale-up (avoid OOM bursts) but fast scale-down for cost. recommended settings?

ryan: set scale-up-delay to 60s, scale-up-limit to 3 nodes; for scale-down use 300s and a utilization threshold 0.5. For spot we prefer a mixed-job approach: baseline on reserved nodes (2-4) + burst spot nodes with taint key `burst=true:PreferNoSchedule`.

sasha: also add nodeAffinity for NV link locality? Not necessary for A10G but if you ever add A100 keep pods aware of topology.

marta: quota request template:```
Project: redwood-prod
Region: europe-west6
SKU: A10G
Requested additional: 24 GPUs
Reason: Canary ML serving pool for low-latency hosted customers. Autoscaling caps and cost controls set. Contact: marta@redwood.ai
```

kai: cool. I'll open the quota ticket and post the TF change. one more ask: any egress/NAT concerns for new nodes?

sre-oncall: yes — the new pool will need NAT IPs if egress to 3rd-party model stores. if you're adding many nodes check reserved NAT gateway scaling. also update firewall to allow monitoring/metrics endpoints.

infra-bot: suggested gcloud command to request quota (copy/paste):
```
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west6 --format=json
# then file ticket at https://go/infra-quotas with above template
```

dev: after quota is approved i'll submit a PR with TF + helm values for gpu-operator pinned to the tested tag and a small smoke test job that runs `nvidia-smi` and a 1-token infer to validate GPU scheduling.

kai: awesome — timeline: i'll file quota request today, target pool up next week if approved. thanks all :thumbsup:
